meaning.zh:
“妒忌去吧” 或 “羡慕去吧”。

这个短语源自古希腊文学，原文描述的是一种极度的情感，尤其是指内心的痛苦或妒忌。用现代的语境来说，“eat your heart out” 表达的是一种自豪感或者炫耀的姿态，意在让别人感到妒忌。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from ancient Greek literature, where it described an intense emotion, especially inner suffering or jealousy. In modern usage, "eat your heart out" expresses a sense of pride or a show-off attitude, meant to invoke envy in others.

lines.en: I've got front-row tickets to see Taylor Swift. Eat your heart out!
lines.zh: 我拿到了泰勒·斯威夫特演唱会的前排票。羡慕去吧！

lines.en: Check out my new car. Eat your heart out!
lines.zh: 看看我的新车。妒忌去吧！

lines.en: I'm going on a month-long vacation to Hawaii. Eat your heart out!
lines.zh: 我即将去夏威夷度假一个月。羡慕去吧！
